metadata.description: teamcall: a company's people from chat to a terminal agent in 30 days - pilot, fast path, champions, a daily card in Telegram or WhatsApp, journal, six measurements, scale or stop. Buys nothing.

plugins.name: teamcall
plugins.description: A pilot from 5 people to 30-50, a 20-minute fast path, a 5-hour champion path, one command for a repeated task, one short card a day in Telegram or WhatsApp on leading an agent (done / show me / skip), a transition journal, a report on six measurements and the card answers, and a scale-or-stop page; which seat already pays for which terminal agent. Buys nothing.
